settings.description_text:
Gaslamp on 3rd
269 3rd Ave S, Twin Falls

settings.editor: Grab seven friends, name your team something ridiculous, and play for Idaho kids. Dinner, drinks, trivia, comedy and a bidding war — all under one roof on 3rd Avenue.

settings.description_text: A full dinner is included with every ticket, plus one drink ticket to get the night started.
Multiple rounds, big screens, and bragging rights on the line. Come as a table of eight or let us seat you.
Comedian Michael Beers hosts, keeps score, and may gently roast your table along the way.
Bid on packages donated by Magic Valley businesses and neighbours. Auction catalogue posts closer to the night.
One raffle ticket comes with your seat. More are available on the night — bring cash or a card.
Pop a balloon, win what's inside. Prizes are stuffed in by our Balloon Sponsor — in their brand colours.

settings.editor: [HOST BIO — 60 to 80 words from the client. Where he's from, where he's performed, and why he said yes to hosting for Idaho Playground Project.]
Expect fast rounds, sharp commentary and absolutely no mercy for the table that googles an answer.

settings.title: Every kid deserves a playground they can actually use

settings.editor: Idaho Playground Project builds inclusive, accessible playgrounds so that children with mobility and sensory needs aren't stuck watching from the sidelines. One night of trivia pays for real equipment on real schoolyards.
